设置区域，停留达到指定时间后触发一次。: Define a region and trigger once after a set dwell time.
以髋部中心判断区域。: Uses the centre of the hips.
停留达标触发一次；移出区域后可再次触发。追踪丢失会中断计时。: Triggers once after dwelling. Leave the region to trigger again. Lost tracking interrupts timing.
设置区域后直接运行，无需录制和训练。: Set a region and start. No recording or training required.
已触发，请移出区域: Triggered — leave the region to rearm
比较拇指尖与食指尖。: Compares the thumb tip and index fingertip.
比较上唇与下唇中心。: Compares the centres of the upper and lower lips.
比较双手腕；上方规则为双手高于肩部。: Compares the wrists; above checks both hands above shoulders.
满足关系后触发一次；关系解除后可再次触发。: Triggers once after the relationship holds; release it to trigger again.
设置关系后直接运行，无需录制和训练。: Set a relationship and start. No recording or training required.

同意将录音经本网站发送至 OpenAI，使用我的 API 额度。Key、录音和转: I consent to sending recordings through this server to OpenAI using my API credits. Keys, recordings and transcripts are not saved in projects or logs.
读取本机麦克风 RMS 电平（0–1），不是分贝。最多每秒输出 10 次。: Reads local microphone RMS level (0–1), not decibels. Sends up to 10 updates per second.
连续发送 0–1 数值；停止读取不会发送零值。: Continuously sends values from 0 to 1. Stopping does not send zero.
首次结果与 YES/NO 变化时输出；相同结果不重复发送。异常和停止不输出。: Sends the first result and each YES/NO change. Unchanged results, errors and stopped checks do not send.
API 计数是估计值，拥挤或遮挡可能影响结果。: API counts are estimates. Crowding and occlusion may affect results.
已触发，请解除关系: Triggered — release the relationship to rearm
请开通语音听写（流式版），填写该服务的三项凭证；仅保留在当前页面。: Enable Speech Dictation (Streaming) and enter its three credentials. They stay on this page only.
请应用 API 配置并确认音频发送。: Apply API settings and consent to sending audio.
音频文件不能超过 10 MB。: Audio files must be no larger than 10 MB.
源音频需为 0.1–60 秒，送检片段最多 10 秒。: Source audio must be 0.1–60 seconds; submitted clips are limited to 10 seconds.

连接 Arduino，完成第一次测试发送。: Connect Arduino and send your first test command.
一块 Arduino、可传输数据的 USB 线、Arduino IDE，以及支持: An Arduino board, a USB data cable, Arduino IDE, and desktop Chrome or Edge with Web Serial support.
安装 Arduino IDE，接入开发板，在 IDE 中选择对应板型和端口。: Install Arduino IDE, plug in the board, and select its board type and port.
下载下方 Serial 点灯案例，用 Arduino IDE 打开并上传。该案例: Download the Serial LED example below, open it in Arduino IDE and upload it. The built-in LED is only a receipt demonstration.
上传完成后关闭 IDE 的串口监视器和其他占用串口的程序，再回到 Platfor: After uploading, close the IDE Serial Monitor and other apps using the port, then return to Platform.
打开项目，选择 Serial 输出；点击“选择设备”并授权正确的开发板。: Open a project, select Serial output, then choose and authorise your board.
波特率填写 115200，发送内容填写 /success，结束符选择 LF（换行: Set baud rate to 115200, message to /success, and line ending to LF. Connect, then select Test send.
案例收到 /success 后板载灯亮起，约 3 秒后熄灭。网页显示“已写入”只: The example turns on the built-in LED for about 3 seconds after /success. A browser write confirmation does not confirm device execution; check the board.
连续控制或音量映射请使用“Serial 数值接收”案例，发送纯数字并选择 LF；: For continuous control or mapped audio level, use the Serial numeric receiver, send a plain number with LF, and use the received value in your code. The example prints each received value.
创建 Broker，把消息发送给 ESP32-S3。: Create a broker and send messages to ESP32-S3.
Platform → MQTT Broker → ESP32-S3。网页发布消息: Platform → MQTT broker → ESP32-S3. The browser publishes and the ESP32 subscribes to the same topic.
打开下方 EMQX 官方创建教程，在控制台注册并创建 Serverless 部署: Follow the EMQX deployment guide below, register in its console and create a Serverless deployment. Check the provider for current free quotas and regions.
只想使用免费额度时，把 Spend Limit 保持为 0。到访问控制／身份认证: To use only the free quota, keep Spend Limit at 0. Create an MQTT user under Access Control / Authentication and note the host, ports and certificate. MQTT credentials are separate from website login credentials.
输出选择 MQTT，填写控制台提供的 wss:// WebSocket URL、: Select MQTT output. Enter the console's wss:// WebSocket URL, MQTT credentials and a topic such as project/action. Include port and path in the URL.
EMQX Serverless 当前通常提供 WSS 8084 与 MQTT T: EMQX Serverless currently commonly uses WSS 8084 and MQTT TLS 8883. Always follow your deployment console. Save settings before connecting.
安装 Arduino-ESP32 3.x 开发板包和 PubSubClient: Install the Arduino-ESP32 3.x board package and PubSubClient library. Download an MQTT example and select your ESP32-S3 board.
在 .ino 中填写 Wi-Fi 和 MQTT 配置。MQTT_HOST 只填主: Enter Wi-Fi and MQTT settings in the .ino file. MQTT_HOST contains only the hostname, without wss://, port or /mqtt. MQTT_PORT is the device TCP/TLS port.
使用云端 TLS 时设置 MQTT_USE_TLS=true，填写可信根证书；T: For cloud TLS, set MQTT_USE_TLS=true and paste the trusted root CA. Match the topic and trigger payload exactly. The LED example expects YES on project/action.
先用 MQTTX 订阅同一 Topic，确认网页“测试发送”的消息能到达 Bro: Subscribe to the same topic in MQTTX and check a Platform test message reaches the broker. Then check the ESP32 serial logs to locate browser, broker or device issues.
Broker 确认接收不等于 ESP32 已执行。连续数值输出请下载 MQTT: Broker acknowledgement does not confirm ESP32 execution. For continuous output, download the MQTT numeric receiver.
固定指令与连续数值，选择对应接收程序。: Choose a receiver for commands or continuous values.
动作触发或 YES/NO 判断：先用点灯案例核对连接，再替换成自己的交互逻辑。S: For gestures or YES/NO checks, first verify the connection with an LED example, then replace its action. Serial expects /success while MQTT expects YES.
连续控制或音量映射：使用数值接收案例。发送纯数字，Serial 选择 LF；默认: For continuous control or audio mapping, use a numeric receiver and send plain numbers. Serial requires LF. Examples accept decimals and negative values; stopping output does not imply zero.
下载前查看文件名与说明。MQTT 的 Wi-Fi、主机、证书和账号密码需要在自己: Check filenames and descriptions. Fill MQTT Wi-Fi, host, certificates and credentials in your own program; website credentials are not inserted into downloads.
这些代码是接收示例，不代表已在你的开发板上编译或烧录。不同板卡的 LED 引脚、: These are receiver examples, not confirmation they have been compiled or flashed for your board. LED pins, serial ports and USB settings vary.
串口、Topic、认证与发送格式逐项检查。: Check ports, topics, authentication and message format.
检查 USB 线是否支持数据传输，确认板卡驱动和端口可被 Arduino IDE: Use a USB data cable, check the board driver and verify Arduino IDE detects the port. Use desktop Chrome or Edge with Web Serial.
关闭其他占用该串口的程序。选择设备后核对 USB 标识，波特率须与 Serial: Close other programs using the port. Check the selected USB device and match the baud rate to Serial.begin.
检查网页是否使用 wss:// 地址、正确的 WebSocket 端口与路径。设: Use the correct wss:// URL, WebSocket port and path. A device TCP/TLS port such as 8883 is not a browser WebSocket endpoint.
核对 MQTT 用户名密码、服务是否运行、免费额度以及 Topic 的发布／订阅: Check MQTT credentials, service status, quotas, and topic publish/subscribe permissions. Do not confuse account login and MQTT passwords.
已连接但设备没有反应: Connected but device does not react
核对 Topic 的大小写、斜杠与发送内容。Serial 案例需要 /succe: Match topic case, slashes and payload. The Serial example needs /success with LF; the MQTT example needs YES. Start with Test send.
用 MQTTX 或设备日志检查实际收到的内容，再核对程序订阅与处理逻辑。网页写入: Inspect received payloads in MQTTX or device logs, then check subscriptions and processing. Browser writes and broker acknowledgements do not confirm device execution.
灯不亮或数值不对: LED or numeric output looks wrong
ESP32-S3 板载 RGB 灯的引脚因板型不同；先确认自己的板卡资料。连续数: ESP32-S3 RGB LED pins vary by board. Check your board documentation. Use numeric examples for continuous values, rather than a fixed-YES LED sketch.
音量输入是 RMS 电平而非分贝；校准输入低高点，再检查输出映射范围。接收程序只: Audio input is RMS level, not decibels. Calibrate input endpoints and check the mapped output range. Receivers only get sent values; stopping does not reset them.
案例下载不代表已完成编译、烧录或设备执行。: Downloading an example does not mean it has been compiled, flashed or executed by a device.
资料核对：2026-11-06。服务套餐与控制台界面以官方当前信息为准。: Resources checked: 2026-11-06. Refer to current official plans and console interfaces.
地址示例：网页 wss://YOUR_HOST:8084/mqtt；ESP32: Example: browser wss://YOUR_HOST:8084/mqtt; ESP32 host YOUR_HOST, TLS port 8883. Replace YOUR_HOST and follow your console for ports and paths.
